product_one_liner.value: Lyric Studio is an AI-native platform for enterprise supply-chain teams to model, plan, and make operational decisions across their supply chains.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes Lyric Studio as a supply-chain planning, modeling, and decision-intelligence platform for enterprises.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation and footer offer no pricing page or pricing link; the site directs prospective customers toward a demo/contact flow.

named_customers.notes: Both are identified in Lyric customer stories; these are customers, not merely partners or investors.

employee_band.notes: Lyric's LinkedIn company profile lists company size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: The company information page gives the headquarters as Sunnyvale, California, United States.

founded_year.notes: Lyric's company information page states that it was founded in 2021.

eng_blog.notes: Lyric publishes at least two technical posts about its forecasting and supply-planning methods. The authors are identified as a Principal Applied Scientist and a Principal Research Scientist, respectively.

public_docs.notes: The homepage navigation/footer does not link to product documentation, a help center, or a developer portal; it links to company resources and trust/security information instead.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live board lists open roles, including OR Scientist, but the role titles found do not contain AI, ML, machine learning, data science, applied scientist, research scientist, NLP, LLM, or computer vision. Machine-learning-related language in a job description is not itself a qualifying title.

model_provider.notes: Lyric's platform, AI information, blog, and security/trust material describe its own models and tools, including NVIDIA cuOpt and Gurobi, but do not publicly identify a specific generative-AI model or model provider used by the product.

compliance_certs.notes: Lyric says it is ISO 27001 certified and SOC 2 attested; its trust information also names GDPR alignment. GDPR is included because it is one of the requested named compliance standards.

last_funding.notes: Lyric announced a $43.5 million Series B on August 5, 2025, bringing total funding to $67 million.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 2025 Series B fell within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Lyric's active jobs board includes an Enterprise Account Executive opening.

launched_6mo.notes: The readable resource index shows recent dated posts, but the August 2026 demand-forecasting article is an explanatory blog post rather than a product-launch announcement. Crescendo, labeled new in 2026, is a training program, not a product or major feature launch. No qualifying launch announcement was found in the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Lyric CEO Ganesh Ramakrishna announced that Sean Zonneveld was joining Lyric as EVP of Sales; the post is marked approximately six months before the run date, within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Lyric's privacy policy names HubSpot for marketing and forms and HubSpot Ads for advertising/campaign measurement.
